verses.english: “There are these two kinds of hospitality.
Hospitality in things of the flesh and hospitality in the teaching.
These are the two kinds of hospitality.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ paṭisanthārānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammapaṭisanthāro”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of hospitality is hospitality in the teaching.”
